title: Hearty Middle Eastern Oat Milk Labneh
description: A yeasty and pillowy Middle Eastern dish featuring oat milk, bhuna, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, served in a traditional molcajete vessel.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the oat milk, bhuna spice mix, and active dry yeast, stirring gently to dissolve the yeast.
Let the mixture sit at room temperature for 10 minutes, or until it becomes frothy and bubbly.
Add the salt, lemon juice, and garlic to the mixture, stirring to combine.
Pour the mixture into a molcajete vessel or a similar ceramic bowl.
Drizzle the olive oil over the top of the mixture.
Cover the vessel with a clean cloth and let it sit in a warm, draft-free place for 4 hours, or until the labneh has thickened and set.
Once set, refrigerate the labneh for at least 30 minutes to chill before serving.
Serve the labneh chilled, garnished with fresh herbs or spices if desired.
